translation: Mapped official python/pip package lists, editable install arguments, and exact FEA-Bench test_cmd plus FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS labels into the existing local-venv runner. Official pre_install commands are retained verbatim per task but not run because they include Docker/Linux system package operations and source-file rewrites; Python version requirements are recorded, while the runner currently uses the host Python. These are environment adaptations, and environment setup/check failures will be terminal preparation outcomes, never generated-code failures.
